stories.title: Shoes launch sub-two hour marathon times
stories.summary: Two marathoners clocked in under two hours in London. We talk to one researcher about the role of shoes in making the impossible possible.

stories.title: Colombia's election takes a tense turn with wave of pre-election violence
stories.summary: Colombia's presidential race unfolds amid weekend bomb attacks and rising fears of political violence ahead of May's vote. The left-wing frontrunner is trailed by a fragmented right-wing opposition.

stories.title: How the city with the most to lose in the Colorado River crisis is trying to adapt
stories.summary: Record low winter snows mean insufficient water in the Colorado River. Here's how a city that's first in line to be cut off is handling it.

stories.title: Can the famous Rocky statue punch through political disagreements?
stories.summary: Philadelphia's Rocky statue gets as many visitors as the Statue of Liberty. Now the Philadelphia Museum of Art is trying to use it to create dialogue between people who disagree.

stories.title: King Charles urges 'reconciliation' in address to U.S. Congress amid Trump tensions
stories.summary: In an address to the U.S. Congress, King Charles told lawmakers that "time and again, our two countries have always found ways to come together," and called for "reconciliation and renewal."

stories.title: As school choice expands in Iowa, one district is in a crisis from losing students
stories.summary: With school choice programs ascendant not just in Iowa but across the U.S., Cedar Rapids offers a preview of who wins and who loses when education meets the free market.
